matches.rationale: All three findings identify the Bregman divergence definition error in Section 2.3. Pred_id 1 formally refutes Lemma 2.1 using the printed definition and shows it works with the corrected convention. Pred_id 5 directly identifies the gradient-at-y vs gradient-at-p inconsistency. Pred_id 7 shows the proof of Lemma 2.1 uses gradient-at-p while the definition has gradient-at-y. All point to the same defect in the same formula.

Pred_id 2 directly identifies the wrong inequality direction in the strong convexity definition in Section 2.4, noting the printed '≤' should be '≥' and that this contradicts the subsequent statement about Bregman divergence bounds. This exactly matches the ground truth defect.

Pred_id 9 identifies the inconsistency in calibration error definition, noting Section 2.1 has a spurious 1/T factor while the introduction and all theorem statements use the un-normalized sum. This matches the ground truth's identification of the incorrect 1/T normalization in the formal definition.
